title: meta.improve-actions output
description: Either a grounded revision proposal or a no-change verdict. `skillMdAfter` is required unless `noChange` is true.

actionName.description: The action reviewed. Must match the envelope's actionName.

summary.description: For a proposal: what changed, why, and a justification of the net line delta. For a no-change verdict: what was examined and why nothing warranted a change.

skillMdAfter.description: Full revised SKILL.md including frontmatter. Written verbatim on approval.

noChange.description: True when the evidence did not support a change. Records a reviewed entry in the action's history instead of a review card.

evidence.description: Cited observations backing the proposal, each naming the runs or counts it rests on. At least two distinct runIds per instruction change; a denial verdict belongs here too, cited by its `id`.
